params.prompt: Locked-off static close-up, no camera movement, shallow depth of field. A thin, clear, steady stream of water keeps pouring from the nozzle into the glass for the whole shot without stopping; the water level rises from about one third to two thirds of the glass; small bubbles swirl; light glints on the water surface. The appliance, the lever and the glass stay perfectly still and unchanged. No hands, no people, no lever movement, no appliance morphing, no overflowing, no splashing, no extra streams, no focus shift, no text changes.
